Only use the recommended coolant checking that the concentration is 50% water and 50% anti-freeze. The anti-freeze not only has the function of protecting the entire cooling system from freezing but it also protects the parts that are in contact with the coolant from corrosion and limescale. Therefore the benefits of anti-freeze should not be underestimated even in tropical climates.

In addition to the mixture ratio, the quality of the water also plays an important role. Drinking water normally satisifes these requirements; the quality of regenerated sea water is not good enough.

Anti-freeze that is not approved can cause damage to the engine.

If the radiator, the cylinder head or the cylinder head gasket is replaced, do not reuse the used coolant.
